criteria.requirement: Add explicit cat(..., duplicate_fields="occurrence") policy using (field name, occurrence number); default duplicate_fields="first" preserves ALL original frozen duplicate-first behavior. The opt-in policy must implement preserving every value for a single table and N-source union headers with maximum occurrence counts in stable discovery order. Explicit output header occurrence order, short rows, missing markers, empty sources and normal unique-field alignment remain correct. Build mapping once per source, do not silently select first occurrence for all duplicates or discard repeated columns.
